headline: Garden Guard: an original lane-defense orchard siege
lede: A Plants-vs-Zombies-lineage lane defense with its own autumn-orchard IP is live — bank acorns, plant critters, hold five goblin lanes to a flagged final wave. Five levels, six unlockable defenders, a Warlord boss, all art and audio synthesized in code.

notes.text: GARDEN GUARD shipped (#839): five-lane lawn, acorn economy, scarecrow-mowers, waves that build to a big final wave, and a defender unlock per level.
Six counters vs five goblin types — Daisy economy, Squirrel shots, Hedgerow walls, Chili splash, Frostcap slow, Pumpkin lob — with a depth-first autopilot that lines every lane and nukes lone tanks.
gardencheck (pure Node) drives the same sim the shipping build runs: boot + 14 core-rule gates + winnable on 5 seeds + determinism, 32/32 green; contractcheck 15/15.
